grid_roles.1536: historical diagnostic only; historical mass failure
grid_roles.3072: minimum prior class-comparison grid, NOT locally resolved production DSS
grid_roles.12288: resolved baseline at this amplitude, new pair
grid_roles.49152: not run here; separate preregistered extension if pair inconclusive or three-grid order needed and CI budget allows

mass.policy: closed/near-vacuum boundary: both raw drift and independent integrated signed flux residual <1% of initial domain mass. Open-boundary physical loss is not numerical error; use flux-corrected residual, separately report raw drift. Same R4B1 Einstein time equation and trapezoid quadrature, no independent solver.

convergence.common_support: 0 to min final central proper time, 32769 samples, no shift or fit
convergence.scope: new fixed pair only; report stricter R4B1 10%/10% in parallel; never retroactively change R4B1; two-grid agreement is not asymptotic convergence or a continuum error bound

boundary.policy: same h, weak pulse propagates through r=12.5; actual outer-face field reconstruction versus interior flux at same radius in larger domain, same coordinate end time, slight lapse gauge difference not removed; no manufactured flux substitution

adaptive.rule: same R4B1 four fitted negative slopes and negative endpoint differences, inner mass <5%, C<.2, mass and flux budgets, no earlier trapping; exact independent early/full prefix, full class and mass gates; two new initial-profile superpositions fixed before execution
adaptive.scope: new deterministic profile families, not blinded external data; not near-critical universality proof
